digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify matrix / GitHub Actions CI workflow
propositions: Ubuntu Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 cells independently run identical pytest default and integration tiers with identical coverage instrumentation, causing duplicate measurement and runner occupancy without distinct coverage verdict.
Coverage tracing adds ~34 seconds wall-clock overhead per uninstrumented cell per run, confirmed by A-B-B-A-A-B experiment on identical checkout/host/tests.

Only Ubuntu Python 3.13 (newest stable, paired with sole macOS cell) should collect branch coverage and enforce fail-under; Python 3.11 and 3.12 must retain all test tiers but run uninstrumented to free runner-seconds.

Django, NumPy, and SciPy current workflows all selectively collect coverage on one primary or dedicated configuration while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing consensus precedent.

Workflow contract must verify all four matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13, macOS 3.13) retain both test tiers; only Ubuntu 3.13 receives coverage flags; all other cells receive empty string (not flags), avoiding GitHub Actions falsy empty-string trap.
